name: Illinois Iron Inc. - Architectural Metals , Rails , Fences , Custom Fabrication
old_description: Custom Metal Fabrication for the Finest Commercial Environments
about:
Illinois Iron Inc. operates from Rockford, Illinois, where it was founded in 1998 as a modest welding operation. The company has grown over two decades into a recognized architectural metal fabricator serving the Midwest and beyond.

The shop specializes in custom architectural metalwork, producing precision-crafted railings, cladding, trim, stair components, countertops, bar fronts, wall cladding, screens, partitions, signage, and storefront elements. In-house capabilities include welding, powder coating, and a range of finish options such as patinas, brushed metals, and custom coatings, allowing end-to-end control from raw material to finished piece.

Its customer base includes architects, builders, designers, and millwork firms on commercial, hospitality, and public-space projects. Notable installations include the PNC Building in downtown Chicago for millwork partner Bernhard WoodWork, as well as restaurants, hotels, and retail storefronts across Illinois.

The company states its founding mission was to deliver precision-engineered metalwork that elevates architectural design while standing the test of time, rooted in honest communication, superior craftsmanship, and dedication to customer satisfaction. Expanded finish capabilities now enable full end-to-end solutions aligned with design intent.
